goal: Read a freee accounting master record through a list-to-detail chain
description: Resolve the current company, list its account items, select one returned ID, and read the same account item by ID without modifying data.

steps.action: Resolve the currently selected freee company and capture its company_id
List account items for that company and select the first returned item with an integer id
Read the selected account item by id and verify that the returned id matches
